notes:
ships-profiler-A (plant-profiler A), v-shipbuilding-naval, retrieved 2026-11-13. 10 plants profiled.

Saronic Franklin material = 4 under the vertical's aluminum-first boundary rule even though Path's release places its cells at Franklin (sensitivity 20). Saronic part mix 8 (series production: 'repeatable system designed to build fleets'). Charleston demand rests on the Jan 2025 acquisition close, not the Oct 2026 hiring event. Ingalls scale 10 uses a division headcount (inferred to site; no confidence). LAD and Keel company-level pages earn points but no confidence.
SITE TIES: NNS main postings are tied to the main shipyard by the shipfitter text ('across the shipyard... dry-docks, and onboard ships'), HII's Oct 16 2026 release ('hiring skilled trades at its main shipyard'), and the board's separate 'Offsite Location' marking for OPIP. HII's board has only one Goose Creek employer site (Charleston Operations); Keel's Goose Creek listings are on Keel's own board, not HII's.
RELATIONSHIPS: Keel x3 changed new -> lookalike of HII (rule b). The Hollywood old row is retired via evidence_remove. The Ladson and Goose Creek old relationship rows, the LAD WorkBoat MARAD triggers row and the Keel Goose Creek board welder_postings row share claim_id and source_url with new rows, so the upsert overwrites them; they are deliberately not in evidence_remove, so a removal run after the merge cannot delete the new rows. LAD stays customer_other_plant: Path names no site and LAD has three facilities; which LAD sites build barges is not stated (USACE barges are built in Morgan City).

Keel Hollywood: Keel says Meggett, EPA says Yonges Island, Paylocity says Hollywood (one site, 4194 Hwy 165).
